# Afsnit 342: Nervøsitet i AI-aktier

**Feed**: investeringspodcasten  
**Published**: 2026-10-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Danish hosts doubt that Trump's claimed Russia-Ukraine energy and diesel deal will lower oil prices before the US midterms. They expect oil to stay high, which keeps pressure on consumer stocks. They see nervousness in AI stocks (Micron, CoreWeave, Iren) because of Oracle's debt load and the timing of Anthropic's IPO. They welcome Danish upgrades from Demant, Jyske Bank and Torm. In weight-loss drugs they see Eli Lilly as the clear winner, with little investor appetite for Novo Nordisk, Zealand Pharma or Viking.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 DEMANT — Demant | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Raised guidance, the Reveal US launch is going well, and the buyback has restarted. Shares have doubled, which shows momentum.

#### Reasoning

The hosts say direction and momentum matter more than valuation. Demant raised its growth and EBIT guidance and restarted a buyback of up to DKK 3bn, and the US Reveal launch has been well received. The shares have already doubled, so it is a positive momentum hold, not a fresh value buy. The hosts disclaim any recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Reveal momentum in the US fades
- if guidance is cut again
- if competition squeezes margins

> *"De hæver deres omsætningsvækstovervindinger fra 6,7 til 7,8. Så hæver de EBIT fra 4,48, altså 4,4 milliarder og 4,8 milliarder, til 4,7, 5,0."*

---

### 🟡 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Raised outlook. Rising rates and near-zero loan losses make it 'the best of all worlds' for Danish banks.

#### Reasoning

Danish banks benefit from higher market rates and wider interest margins while borrowers keep paying. Jyske has delivered well for several quarters and is cutting costs and absorbing Handelsbanken's Danish business. The hosts are positive, but no explicit buy call is made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall sharply
- if credit losses rise
- if the Handelsbanken integration hits problems

> *"så er det jo lidt mindre overraskende, at Jyske Bank, som jo faktisk har leveret rigtig, rigtig fint de seneste kvartaler, kommer og løfter forventningerne"*

---

### 🟡 TRMD-A — Torm | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Raised EBITDA guidance by about 20% on high tanker rates from Middle East tensions. Overhang is gone after Oaktree's exit, and a Hafnia merger is possible.

#### Reasoning

Tanker rates are very high because of the Middle East and Hormuz tensions ('when the world is on fire, Torm does well'). The seller overhang has cleared, there is merger optionality with Hafnia, and the stock could enter C25. The case depends on geopolitical rates, so it is shorter-term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Middle East tensions ease and rates normalise
- if the Hafnia merger falls through

> *"når verden er i brand, så har Torm det godt"*

---

### 🟡 LLY — Eli Lilly | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

The clear winner in weight loss. Revenue is set to triple to $102bn by 2027, and the oncology pipeline is broad. Host Helge owns it.

#### Reasoning

Investors only want Lilly in the obesity space because it has growth and momentum, even at 30-40x earnings. The hosts call it a sharp competitor with a broad portfolio, which is why Helge holds it. A risk is that Novo's oral pill is taking some share.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Novo's oral pill keeps cannibalising Lilly's prescriptions
- if growth slows against the 30-40x valuation

> *"Eli Lilly, jamen de gør det fantastisk godt med deres produkter"*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cheap at 10-12x earnings but no investor appetite. The oral pill is gaining; owners need patience.

#### Reasoning

The hosts say a low valuation alone does not trigger buying; it takes growth and momentum. Novo's pill is taking share from Lilly, but investors are still uninterested. It is a patience case. Helge holds it and is ambivalent.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the oral pill's share gains stall
- if Novo makes an expensive, risky acquisition

> *"det gælder om nogensinde at være en tålmodig investor, hvis man vil være i alt andet end Elalili inden for det her segment"*

---

### ⛔ VKTX — Viking Therapeutics | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Rally on phase 2 data was erased after a $500m share issue at $35; the stock is at $27. The hosts say takeover talk comes from holders talking their book.

#### Reasoning

Helge has followed Viking for 3-4 years and says it rallies on small news and then falls back every time. The share issue diluted holders, and approval could be about 4 years away. The hosts are sceptical of takeover hype on X. They state this is not a formal recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a confirmed takeover bid emerges
- if phase 3 data clearly beats competitors

> *"Mange investorer, de har drønet ind i den, og stedet meget på de mindste ting, der er kommet frem med forhåbning og så videre. og så ryger den tilbage hver gang."*

---

### 🟠 ORCL — Oracle | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

One notch above junk because of the debt needed to deliver a $600bn+ backlog, half of it from OpenAI. Could trigger a domino effect in AI.

#### Reasoning

Oracle must spend all of its cash flow and more to service the debt behind its AI buildout. The hosts flag the risk of contagion across AI stocks, especially if rates rise.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Oracle is downgraded to junk
- if OpenAI commitments are cut

> *"Oracle faktisk kun er en streg væk fra junk bond"*

---

### 🟠 ZEAL — Zealand Pharma | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Petrelintide confirmed weight loss with good tolerability, but the blood-sugar reduction disappointed and the stock is fading.

#### Reasoning

The data confirm a well-tolerated weight-loss profile close to placebo, but the smaller-than-expected blood-sugar effect hurt. The hosts see the same fade pattern as Viking, though Zealand has much more cash.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the further phase 2 programmes disappoint
- if partner support weakens

> *"Den her gang, der var det, at reduktionen i blodsukker var for lille."*

---
